{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Roe 2''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] serving the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was part of [[Roe group]] which participated in the [[Skirmish at Outpost D-34]]. Roe 2, along with [[Roe 1]] and [[Roe 3|3]] as well as [[Escro group]], attempted to stop [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial forces]] from capturing [[Onece 3]] of [[Onece group]] which carried their fellow rebels. Both shuttle groups were unsuccessful and were all destroyed in the process.
